title: EchoDate AI
subtitle: An unfinished future for a local assistant.
description: A private, unfinished AI social-assistant concept exploring user preferences, contact-level context, approval boundaries, human takeover and privacy-oriented storage. It is not presented as a finished or validated product. The unfinished structure is part of the archive's character: an idea kept available for a later return.

title: Buzz / Reference
subtitle: External open-source work, held for study.
description: A fork of block/buzz, a hive-mind communication platform. Original authorship remains with its upstream maintainers. This repository is kept for learning and reference; it is not claimed as my original project.

title: Design Systems / Reference
subtitle: A collected language for interfaces.
description: A fork of VoltAgent/awesome-design-md collecting DESIGN.md files inspired by brand design systems. Original authorship and maintenance belong to the upstream contributors. It is a learning reference, not an original project of mine.

title: Image Prompts / Reference
